author: David Bombal
description:
EA SPORTS F1 25 sends live UDP telemetry to the cloud, where it's converted to JSON and fed into Splunk. See how custom Splunk dashboards bring the racing data to life.

Thank you to Cisco for sponsoring my trip to Splunk .conf26! Time to learn more about Splunk! 
#SplunkConf26 #Splunk #Cisco

#Splunk #F1 #DataAnalytics
title: F1 Data Goes Straight Into Splunk

author: David Bombal
description:

How private are the apps you use every day? I sit down with Thorin Klosowski from the Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) to discuss online privacy, secure messaging, VPNs and the data we share with AI tools.

We look at Signal, WhatsApp and Telegram, discuss privacy tradeoffs across Windows, Linux, Android and iPhone, and ask what you should assume about email and cloud storage. Thorin also walks through EFF’s free Surveillance Self-Defense guides to help you create a security plan and decide what to focus on first.

If you work in cybersecurity, or you simply want to help your family protect their privacy, this conversation gives you a starting point without assuming everyone needs the same tools.

- Why “I have nothing to hide” misses the point

title: Think You’re Private Online? Watch This
